messages.content: Hey, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. How have you been feeling this week? Any blood sugar or blood pressure numbers to share?
Pretty good I guess. Blood sugar was 148 before breakfast this morning. Also been trying to eat healthier — what should I be eating instead of white bread? My wife keeps after me about it

Thanks for that — logging your 148 reading now. On the bread question, diet advice is one thing I'm not set up to give, that's outside what I can do. Your provider or a dietitian would be the right people to ask. Is everything going okay with your medications this week?
Yeah mostly fine. I did forget my metformin one morning, took it around lunchtime instead of with breakfast

Good to know — I'll log a note about that. If you start missing doses more often or notice anything feeling off, definitely let me know. Otherwise it sounds like a fairly steady week. I'll get your next check-in lined up for next week. Take care out there.
Sounds good. Thanks for checking in.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
